methods: scoring with task-specific guidelines on a scale of 1 to 10

answer_4.quote: We randomly sampled 100 dialogues from MT-Bench-101 and recruited five expert human annotators to assess the overall quality of multi-turn dialogues based on whether the responses of LLMs met the requirements of the corresponding tasks.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators rated each dialogue on a scale of 1 to 10 based on whether the responses met the task requirements.
